title: linaria biebersteinii subsp. ruthenica
intro: Linaria biebersteinii subsp. ruthenica, commonly known as the toadflax or Russian toadflax, is a perennial plant species in the family Plantaginaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation, gastrointestinal problems, and respiratory conditions, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and possess anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of Linaria biebersteinii subsp. ruthenica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
